title: Restore the optimized release and dist profiles after the build-profile purge
goal: 58062432f set [profile.release] to opt-level 0 (no LTO, 256 codegen units, incremental, unstripped) and removed [profile.dist], so cargo local-build production, the installer's --release build and the published binaries would ship unoptimized; the v0.21.52 Linux binaries had to be built with CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_* environment overrides. Restore the optimized release profile (opt-level 3, thin LTO, 16 codegen units, no incremental cache, panic=abort, stripped) and the dist profile (fat LTO, one codegen unit), keep the fast dev and test profiles, and pin the settings with a test so a purge cannot silently return.
